---
name: "nf-core/fastq_align_chromap"
description: "Align high throughput chromatin profiles using Chromap, updating readgroups\
  \ if neccessary and then sort with samtools"
keywords:
- "align"
- "fasta"
- "genome"
- "reference"
- "chromatin profiles"
- "chip-seq"
- "atac-seq"
- "hic"
components:
- "chromap/chromap"
- "picard/addorreplacereadgroups"
- "samtools/sort"
- "samtools/index"
- "samtools/stats"
- "samtools/idxstats"
- "samtools/flagstat"
- "bam_sort_stats_samtools"
input:
- ch_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "List of input FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for single-end and paired-end\
      \ data,\nrespectively. The meta map contains sample information,\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
      \ single_end:false ].\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
- ch_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "Chromap genome index files. The meta map contains reference information,\n\
      e.g. [ id:'test' ].\n\nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(index) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.index"
- ch_fasta_fai:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference fasta file and index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(fasta),\
      \ path(fai) ]\n"
- ch_barcodes:
    type: "file"
    description: "Cell barcode files.\n\nStructure: [ path(barcodes) ]\n"
- ch_whitelist:
    type: "file"
    description: "Cell barcode whitelist file.\n\nStructure: [ path(whitelist) ]\n"
- ch_chr_order:
    type: "file"
    description: "Custom chromosome order.\n\nStructure: [ path(chr_order) ]\n"
- ch_pairs_chr_order:
    type: "file"
    description: "Natural chromosome order for pairs flipping.\n\nStructure: [ path(pairs_chr_order)\
      \ ]\n"
- update_readgroups:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Boolean controling whether the readgroups should be added or updated\n\
      after chromap alignment\n"
output:
- bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Sorted BAM file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- index:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bai,csi}"
- stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools stats output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.stats"
- flagstat:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools flagstat output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(flagstat) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.flagstat"
- idxstats:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools idxstats output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(idxstats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.idxstats"
authors:
- "@JoseEspinosa"
maintainers:
- "@JoseEspinosa"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/chromap/chromap@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/picard/addorreplacereadgroups@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/bam_sort_stats_samtools@0.0.0-6d1763b"
